builder.videoHelpTitle: 📹 How to add your lesson video (step by step)
builder.vh1: Record your lesson video, then open the YouTube app (or youtube.com) and sign in. If you don't have a channel yet, YouTube will create one free when you upload.
builder.vh2: Tap the + (Create) button → Upload a video → choose your lesson video.
builder.vh3: On the Visibility step, choose UNLISTED — not Public, not Private. Unlisted means the video never appears in search or on your channel; only people with the link can watch it.
builder.vh4: Finish the upload, then open the video and tap Share → Copy link.
builder.vh5: Come back here and paste that link into the video box of the lesson. Done!
builder.vhNote: Important: never pick Private (your students wouldn't be able to watch), and don't delete the video from YouTube later — your course plays it from there.
